dialogue_history.content: How is the environmental score calculated?

The environmental score, or Environmental Suitability Index (ESI), is calculated using the formula: 100 - 2.5 * ABS(ambictemp - 20) - POWER(ABS(humepct - 50) / 2, 1.5) - 600 / (illumelux + 100). This formula takes into account ambient temperature, humidity percentage, and illumination to determine the suitability of the environment.

args.question: How is the environmental score calculated?

tool_trajectory.result: The environmental score, or Environmental Suitability Index (ESI), is calculated using the formula: 100 - 2.5 * ABS(ambictemp - 20) - POWER(ABS(humepct - 50) / 2, 1.5) - 600 / (illumelux + 100). args.sql:
CREATE VIEW site_esi AS
SELECT 
    s.zonelabel AS site_name,
    100 - 2.5 * ABS(se.ambictemp - 20) - POWER(ABS(se.humepct - 50) / 2, 1.5) - 600 / (se.illumelux + 100) AS environmental_score
FROM 
    sites s
JOIN 
    scanenvironment se ON s.zoneregistry = se.zoneref;
